purpose: Refit the fixed-L grid of the high-L thermal-backbone scan with the Magnicon XXF-1 Connector Box 10 kHz LPF turned OFF (unity), and with the documented second-order LPF ON as an apples-to-apples comparator, using the same filter-order fitter and c2 fixed to zero in both.
guardrail: c2 is held at zero: c2 is a numerator coefficient defined relative to the Magnicon pole, so it is not meaningful when the pole is removed. Fixed-L rows are sensitivity tests, not an inductance measurement. This is an acquisition-state counterfactual, not evidence that the LPF was actually OFF.
